comments.text: I'm not mad at California. A while ago, I was bragging on my state of Georgia to my brother who lives in Cali. I was going on about how Georgia has everything from mountains, to thousands of lakes, islands and beaches on the east coast, canyons, natural waterfalls, rolling hills, plateaus, fertile soil that can grow practically anything, etc.  Until I compared our tree-covered "little" mountains to California's massive mountain ranges, our 100 miles of coastline to their nearly 850-mile coast;  our rainy seasons to their perfect southern climate; our 70k miles of river vs their 188k miles, etc. It was like, "Whatever you can do, I can do better" in California's favor nearly every time! Oh well, at least Georgia doesn't have all those earthquakes. California replied, "Yeah, but you guys have that hot and humid summertime weather,  And tornadoes!" Ok. (sigh!) Cali wins!
